answer: Proof-of-stake serves as a robust kernel for Sybil resistance, requiring agents to lock capital to earn influence. An attacker aiming to reach the summit of network control must acquire a majority stake, turning the system into a costly meadow of capital-intensive barriers. Because fake identities cannot bypass the economic threshold required for block validation, the cost of an attack scales linearly with the total value secured, rendering widespread identity forgery financially irrational.
